_comment: Structural notices the summary page prints in "What changed" while they are within that section's 100-day window (the hub keeps no editorial change log; owner, 8-Oct-2026). Each notice: id, date, es, en, href.

notices.es: Los módulos Capacidad, Comprometida y Sitios se retiraron el 8 de octubre de 2026 con la salida de las neonubes de la cobertura; sus direcciones llevan a la nota de la metodología que explica el cambio.
notices.en: The Capacity, Committed and Sites modules were retired on 8 October 2026 when the neoclouds left the coverage; their addresses lead to the methodology note that explains the change.
